## About
West Coast Auto Wrecking is a family-owned and operated auto wrecking yard on State Street in Montclair. We supply quality used auto parts and rebuildable vehicles to the eastern Los Angeles area, with a focus on late model domestic cars and trucks.
Reviewers mention friendly, helpful and knowledgeable staff, and several name Ronnie for going above and beyond to get them the parts and information they needed. Some customers drive up from as far as San Diego. We're rated 4.4 from 31 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used auto parts: Quality used auto parts at fair prices.
- Rebuildable vehicles: Rebuildable vehicles available along with parts, at fair prices.
- Free local delivery to repair shops: Repair shops nearby can get parts delivered at no charge.

## FAQ
Q: Do you ship parts?
A: Yes, we offer nationwide shipping on most parts. Call or email us for details on your part.

Q: Should I call before coming in?
A: It's a good idea. Customers who call first to confirm the part is available tell us it was ready for them when they arrived.
